National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey released the physical activity monitor raw data of 2011-2014 in October, 2022. It is .csv format derived from ActiGraph GT3X+. Can GGIR help me process this kind of data to get sleep parameters? I used GGIR to analysis once and once again but failed, so I’m asking for your help.

 

Kind Regards,
